purpose: Source inventory and planned ownership, not deployed capability or acceptance certification. Metadata includes implementation helpers and presentation definitions. Registry exposure and exact option coverage must be verified on the release candidate.
collection_rule: Tracked core/metadata/macros/*.json and transforms/packages/*/{metadata/*.json,skills/*.md} at backend_revision. Exclude package metadata index.json. Every discovered macro/package group has case ownership; this does not assert method/option acceptance.
